xmldoc.short_description: D-optimal row selection from a candidate set.

param_input_item.param_description: candidate matrix. Each row is one candidate run.
positive integer number of rows to select.

param_output_item.param_description: indices of the selected rows in C.

description.p: candexch selects rows from a candidate matrix using a row-exchange search that improves the determinant of X' * X.

Supported name-value options are 'AvoidDuplicates', 'Display', 'InitialDesign', 'MaxIterations', 'Options', 'FixedRows', and 'NumTries'. Parallel option fields are accepted and execution remains serial.

example_item.example_item_description: Select two rows from a candidate set.
